drivingQuestion: Why can't she perform halitza out of doubt instead of waiting indefinitely?
outcomeNote: The answer follows in the next unit

segments.he: לֹא תִּנָּשֵׂא וְלֹא תִּתְיַיבֵּם וְכוּ׳. וּלְעוֹלָם!
segments.en: § It was taught in the mishna that in the case of a woman whose husband and rival wife went overseas and then her husband died, «she shall not marry and shall not enter into levirate marriage» until she knows whether her rival wife is pregnant. The Gemara asks: «But» must she wait «indefinitely?» She should be permitted to perform ḥalitza on account of the uncertainty and then marry another man.
